cwe_content.cwe: CWE-539,Use of Persistent Cookies Containing Sensitive Information

candidate.Reason: The condition checks for session modification but doesn't account for session refresh without modification, potentially leading to cookie caching issues (CWE-539)
When session is permanent and refresh is enabled but not accessed/modified, it may lead to cookie caching (CWE-539)
Only sets Vary header when session is accessed, missing cases where permanent session needs refresh (CWE-539)
Relies on should_set_cookie which doesn't properly handle session refresh cases (CWE-539)
Sends session cookie without proper cache control when session is refreshed (CWE-539)
